xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Logical RPC arrows show the caller awaiting a correlated RabbitMQ response; transport envelopes are abstracted.
Registration success scope; failure compensation is intentionally outside this successful view (register.use-case.ts:43-67). Mail enqueue is not email-delivery proof.
Confirmation GET then DELETE is not atomic consumeUserId; verify_user failure does not reach DELETE.
